token.description: The opaque token from the invitation link, valid seven days. Unknown, expired, revoked and already-accepted all answer `410 token_spent`.

password.description: The password the new account will use, at least 12 characters. **Required while the app's password method is on, refused while it is off** — both as `400 validation_error` naming `password`. An email-code-only app accepts invitations without one.

display_name.description: An optional name, overriding whatever the invitation pre-filled.
